description: `config.json`'s `default_adapter: claude_code` with `binary: circuitry-test-missing-claude` (deliberately missing, never a real CLI): preflight never walks the config's own default adapter, so the run only discovers the missing binary once it actually dispatches, with the A3 start-failure text. The embedded `OSError`'s own strerror text is third-party, masked by the conformance harness's own message-shape catalogue (tests/conformance/README.md); the errno and the path stay exact.
